title: EventBus callback duplicate registration recovery contract

contract.duplicate_registration_isolation: A callback can attempt to register an already registered listener without aborting EventBus.emit()
contract.duplicate_registration_integrity: Repeated registration of an existing listener does not create duplicate registry entries
contract.current_cycle_delivery_once: An already registered listener receives the active broadcast exactly once
contract.post_registration_delivery_once: Subsequent broadcasts continue delivering exactly once per registered listener
contract.registry_integrity: The listener registry remains structurally valid after duplicate registration
contract.unique_owner_integrity: Duplicate registration does not create duplicate owner entries
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful before and after duplicate registration
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration and emit operations require the events permission
